text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the final day of summer camp. As I'm
waiting for Rice Shower to finish
packing, I take a seat on
a nearby
bench.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Ehehe. I got caught up helping
out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This camp has done a lot for me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I asked the administrator if I could do
anything
to help... even though I only
had a little bit of
time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-not really... I couldn't do much,
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just watering flowers... repainting the
benches...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Even the one you're sitting on...
now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Even the one you're sitting on...
now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrriiiip...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stand up in a panic, but the paint has
already
come off the bench onto my
clothes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! I should have left a note!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... What should we do? Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... What should we do? Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay... Sigh... I'm really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll go apologize to the administrator as
well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure they're okay with us
repainting it,
and get some paint while
I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some things never change, while other
aspects of ourselves continuously evolve.
If there's one thing
today has taught me,
it's that.
